expected_answer_points: Identify a specific software design decision (e.g., data model, API design, integration patterns) that led to data quality issues.
Explain the nature of the data quality problem (e.g., inconsistencies, missing data, incorrect data, performance bottlenecks affecting data freshness).
Detail the steps taken to diagnose the root cause of the data quality issue, potentially involving monitoring, logging, or data analysis.
Describe the design modifications or architectural changes implemented to resolve the data quality problem.
Discuss any trade-offs considered during the redesign process (e.g., performance vs. data integrity, complexity vs. maintainability).
Mention how the effectiveness of the solution was measured and validated (e.g., new metrics, dashboards, user feedback).
Reflect on lessons learned regarding the interplay between software design and data quality.
follow_up_questions: How did you measure the impact of your design changes on data quality?
Were there any unforeseen consequences of your design modifications?
What tools or processes did you use to ensure data quality going forward?
How did you balance the need for data quality with other design considerations like performance or scalability?
